'''Aburrey Heavy Armor''' is a {{gear|4|Armor}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
Excavation of Precursor relics can be a rather convoluted process filled with unexpected changes. Equipment used during excavation must offer sufficient protection, dexterity, as well as offensive capabilities.}}
